key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the historical analogy, concealed teaching and purchased-by-Master claim.
key_decisions.before: But false prophets also arose among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.
key_decisions.after: But false prophets also arose among the people, just as false teachers will arise among you. They will secretly introduce destructive teachings, even denying the Master who bought them, and bring swift destruction on themselves.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But false prophets also arose among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the conditional argument and the pinned chains reading with Tartarus explained in a note.
key_decisions.before: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them into Tartarus and committed them to chains of gloomy darkness to be kept until judgment,
key_decisions.after: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them into Tartarus and handed them over to chains of darkness, held for judgment;
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them into Tartarus and committed them to chains of gloomy darkness to be kept until judgment,

key_decisions.rationale: Unpacks eighth Noah as eight survivors and keeps herald and flood.
key_decisions.before: if he did not spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah, a herald of righteousness, with seven others, when he brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly,
key_decisions.after: if he did not spare the ancient world, but protected Noah, a herald of righteousness, along with seven others, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly;
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: if he did not spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah, a herald of righteousness, with seven others, when he brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly,

key_decisions.rationale: Supplies the English then to close the long conditional while preserving present punishment.
key_decisions.before: then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment until the day of judgment,
key_decisions.after: then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trial and to hold the unrighteous under punishment until the day of judgment,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment until the day of judgment,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps flesh, lordship and unnamed glorious beings rather than inventing identities.
key_decisions.before: and especially people who indulge in the desire of defiling passion and despise authority. Bold and willful, they do not tremble as they slander glorious ones,
key_decisions.after: especially those who follow the flesh in defiling desire and despise lordship. Bold and self-willed, they do not tremble at slandering glorious beings,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and especially those who indulge in the desire of defiling passion and despise authority. Bold and willful, they do not tremble as they slander glorious ones,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the comparison and follows the shorter pinned reading without before the Lord.
key_decisions.before: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, do not bring a reviling judgment against them before the Lord.
key_decisions.after: whereas angels, greater in strength and power, do not bring a slanderous judgment against them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, do not bring a reviling judgment against them before the Lord.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned suffering-wrong verb and deceptions reading; keeps social presence.
key_decisions.before: suffering wrong as the wages of their wrongdoing. They count it pleasure to revel in the daytime. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their deceptions while they feast with you,
key_decisions.after: suffering wrong as the wages of wrongdoing. They regard daytime revelry as pleasure. They are stains and blemishes, reveling in their deceptions while they feast with you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: suffering wrong as the wages of their wrongdoing. They count it pleasure to revel in the daytime. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their deceptions while they feast with you,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the predatory lure, trained hearts and curse idiom with the literal eye image noted.
key_decisions.before: having eyes full of adultery, insatiable for sin. They entice unstable souls. They have hearts trained in greed. Accursed children!
key_decisions.after: Their eyes are full of adultery and never stop sinning. They lure unstable souls and have hearts trained in greed. They are children under a curse!
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: having eyes full of adultery, insatiable for sin. They entice unstable souls. They have hearts trained in greed. Accursed children!

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the road repetition and the source's Bosor spelling.
key_decisions.before: Forsaking the straight way, they have gone astray. They have followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved gain from wrongdoing,
key_decisions.after: They have left the straight road and gone astray, following the road of Balaam son of Bosor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Forsaking the straight way, they have gone astray. They have followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved gain from wrongdoing,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the vulnerable group's barely emerging escape and the seduction's means.
key_decisions.before: For speaking loud boasts of folly, they entice by sensual passions of the flesh people who are barely escaping from people who live in error.
key_decisions.after: For with grand but empty words, they use fleshly desires and shameless conduct to lure people who are just escaping from those who live in error.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For speaking loud boasts of folly, they entice by sensual passions of the flesh those who are barely escaping from those who live in error.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the freedom/slavery reversal and its general explanatory maxim.
key_decisions.before: They promise them freedom, but they themselves are slaves of corruption. For whatever overcomes a person, to that he is enslaved.
key_decisions.after: They promise them freedom while they themselves are slaves of corruption. For whatever overcomes a person enslaves that person.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: They promise them freedom, but they themselves are slaves of corruption. For whatever overcomes a person, to that he is enslaved.

key_decisions.after: What the true proverb says has happened to them: “A dog returns to its own vomit,” and, “A washed sow returns to wallowing in mud.”
